name: helloworld-mascot
description: Motion system for the HelloWorld.ie bot — an expressive chat-bubble robot. Character is swappable data; engine/expressions/life are character-agnostic.

principles.three_layers: Every motion drives EYE (eyes), GRP (head group), BOT (whole icon). Smaller/faster parts lead; the heavier BOT follows a beat behind with a slight tilt.
principles.effort: Anticipation (move against the action) -> Action (fast-out ease) -> Follow-through (overshoot + settle). No straight A-to-B lerps.
principles.no_deform_for_travel: Locomotion is pure position; never skew/distort while moving. In-place squash/stretch is OK for energy (jumps, laughs).
principles.momentum: Locomotion is jellyfish pulse-and-glide: gather -> one strong push -> long decelerating coast that settles from a small overshoot.
principles.return_to_rest: Glide to neutral (toRest) before any action; every performance ends with all layers back at neutral.
principles.timing: Segments 0.1-0.7s; whole performances ~0.8-2.5s. Energetic: power2/3.out, back.out. Springy settle: elastic.out(1,0.5-0.7). Calm: sine/power2.inOut.

api.constructor: new Mascot({ mount, character, gsap?, mood?='calm', autoblink?=true, typeSpeed?=82, roam?:{within,padding}, onStatus? })

methods.play(token): Play one performance, a quoted string to type, or 'a & b' to run both at once. Busy-guarded; await it.
methods.run(seq): Play a comma/newline string or array of tokens in order; scatters natural blinks between steps when autoblink is on.
methods.type(str): Eye flies out, becomes a blinking cursor, types str (marquee if overflow), returns to eyes.
methods.setMood(mood): 'still'|'calm'|'float'. In float, pass roam to drift a larger container.

grammar.blink: blink | blink light | blink strong | blink double | blink x3
grammar.combine: a & b  (run both simultaneously, e.g.  found & "Found it!")

still.use: inline beside text, dense UI, reduced-motion

float.motion: jellyfish pulse-glide drift; eyes+tilt lean toward travel; 'bored' beats between moves
float.use: heroes, empty states, loading; pass roam to travel a big canvas

roam.behaviour: whole mascot translates across the container; calm/still glides it back to centre; expressions fire mid-roam.

blink_model.why: Cheapest signal of life and attention. None = dead/frozen; too many = anxious/glitchy.
blink_model.cadence: Irregular, clustered (exponential distribution) around a relaxed mean, with occasional natural double-blinks. Not a metronome.
blink_model.arousal: An internal value rises after energetic performances or fast float moves and briefly raises the blink rate, then decays. Calming actions lower it. Automatic.
blink_model.as_cursor: While typing, the merged eye blinks AS the text cursor.

expressions.name: dizzy
expressions.intent: overwhelmed / too much data / playful error

expressions.name: peek
expressions.intent: ENTRANCE: slides in and bobs to a stop

expressions.name: determined
expressions.intent: 'on it' resolve before a hard task

expressions.name: scan
expressions.intent: SIGNATURE: searching the web for citations (L->R sweep)

expressions.name: found
expressions.intent: results arrive; satisfying 'got it' snap (pair with type)

expressions.name: notfound
expressions.intent: empty state: searches then gives up

type.intent: eye becomes a blinking cursor and types a string; brand suffix auto-accented; typed text is violet

recipes.audit_to_win: curious, scan, working, found & "Found it!", celebrate

authoring_rules.layers: Drive all three layers; BOT moves ~40-60% of the GRP move and a beat behind, with 1-3deg tilt.
authoring_rules.shape: anticipation -> action(fast-out) -> settle(overshoot+ease). No straight lerps.
authoring_rules.travel: No skew/deform if the motion implies travel; in-place squash OK for energy.
authoring_rules.end_neutral: Leave every layer at neutral (no orphaned transform).
authoring_rules.register: Add to the returned map, a CATEGORIES group, and AROUSE (energetic/positive +0.5..+1.6, neutral +0.3..+0.5, calming negative).
authoring_rules.magnitudes: eye darts ±7-22 xPercent (big looks ±38); GRP nod/shake ±6-9; GRP rotation ±3-8deg; jumps yPercent -16..-34.
authoring_rules.scale: Must read at small sizes — prefer one clear gesture over busy combos.

accessibility.reduced_motion: On prefers-reduced-motion: start in 'still', avoid auto sequences, prefer single short performances or blinks.
accessibility.offscreen: Pause when not visible (IntersectionObserver -> setMood('still') or life.stop()); destroy() on unmount.
accessibility.never_block: The mascot is feedback, never a gate; fire on events, don't await it in a user-waiting path.
